name: io.github.rdcahalane/genome-industrial-intelligence
title: Genome Industrial Intelligence
description: Industrial intelligence for AI agents. Conviction scores and diligence for 10,000+ industrials.

tools.name: get_event_risk
tools.description: Graded forecasts for a company: the chance of a sharp earnings drop in 90 days (calibrated, with the factors that move it), and its bankruptcy and credit-stress percentile ranks. Read score_kind and calibrated before treating a number as a probability; graded on get_event_ledger.

tools.name: get_event_book
tools.description: Every scored company ranked for one forecast, riskiest first: head = bankruptcy | earnings_deterioration | credit_deterioration.

tools.name: get_event_ledger
tools.description: The graded record of every forecast: Brier score, AUC and reliability by decile, live and retrospective. Cite it when stating how much to trust a forecast.

tools.name: get_causal_windows
tools.description: Filing windows: companies whose recent SEC filing (officer change, acquisition, activist stake, material agreement) historically raises the odds of a follow-on event, with the filing, the elevated and matched rates, timing and the help companies in that spot tend to need. Pass ticker for one company, or consequence (executive_change | late_filing | restatement | bankruptcy) for a list.

tools.name: get_architecture_debt
tools.description: Fingerprint-era view. Descriptive only: the behavioral fingerprint (archetype, trajectory, conviction) was retired as a predictive signal after four out-of-sample tests found no edge. For whether a company is about to get worse, use get_event_risk and get_causal_windows.

tools.name: get_archetype_candidates
tools.description: Fingerprint-era view. Descriptive only: the behavioral fingerprint (archetype, trajectory, conviction) was retired as a predictive signal after four out-of-sample tests found no edge. For whether a company is about to get worse, use get_event_risk and get_causal_windows.

tools.name: get_shocks
tools.description: Recent detected shocks — the external events the model saw land, by date, ticker, type, and magnitude.

tools.name: get_shock_backtest
tools.description: How each archetype has historically responded to a class of shock: sample size, mean response, hit rate. This is the archetype x shock event study.

tools.name: get_event_window
tools.description: The open event window for a ticker — which events are still in play and how much of the expected response period remains.

tools.name: get_signal
tools.description: Fingerprint-era view. Descriptive only: the behavioral fingerprint (archetype, trajectory, conviction) was retired as a predictive signal after four out-of-sample tests found no edge. For whether a company is about to get worse, use get_event_risk and get_causal_windows.

industry.description: Optional industry hint (e.g. hvac, auto, aerospace_defense)

tools.name: get_screener
tools.description: Fingerprint-era view. Descriptive only: the behavioral fingerprint (archetype, trajectory, conviction) was retired as a predictive signal after four out-of-sample tests found no edge. For whether a company is about to get worse, use get_event_risk and get_causal_windows.

signal.description: Filter by signal: STRONG_BUY, BUY, WATCH, NEUTRAL, SELL, STRONG_SELL

archetype.description: Filter by archetype: constrained, oscillatory, fragile, resilient, saturated, decoupled

tools.name: get_ecl
tools.description: Macro environmental pressure scores for an industry from live FRED data. Descriptive context, not a forecast.

industry.description: Optional industry for sector-specific ECL weights

tools.name: get_horizons
tools.description: Fingerprint-era view. Descriptive only: the behavioral fingerprint (archetype, trajectory, conviction) was retired as a predictive signal after four out-of-sample tests found no edge. For whether a company is about to get worse, use get_event_risk and get_causal_windows.

tools.name: get_supply_chain
tools.description: Get upstream supply chain risk for a ticker — which upstream industries are stressed and how much that drags the conviction score.

tools.name: get_pfsl
tools.description: Pre-financial readings from SEC EDGAR filings (operational stress, demand velocity, capex intensity). Descriptive, not a forecast.

tools.name: get_regime
tools.description: Fingerprint-era view. Descriptive only: the behavioral fingerprint (archetype, trajectory, conviction) was retired as a predictive signal after four out-of-sample tests found no edge. For whether a company is about to get worse, use get_event_risk and get_causal_windows.

tools.name: get_diligence
tools.description: The company report (v2), billed per call on a paid key: a verdict, the graded forecasts, the open filing windows with their SEC filings, leadership on file, the OSHA/EPA/hiring record and questions for management. format='json_compact' drops the evidence chains.

format.description: Output format: 'full' (default) or 'json_compact' for token-efficient agent use

tools.name: ask_genome
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question answered from live Genome data, e.g. 'Which of these companies are most likely to report a sharp earnings drop next quarter?' or 'Which manufacturers just changed CFO?'. Not investment advice.

context_tickers.description: Optional list of tickers to include as context
